title: Fin Box Lower Rib — Lightning Strike Damage Repair at the Attachment Region
abstract: Repair of lightning strike damage on the fin box lower rib in the attachment region, covering burn mark assessment, fastener replacement and the bonding checks that release the repair.

sections.purpose: This repair covers lightning strike damage found on the fin box lower rib in the attachment region, where the current path concentrates at the fastener rows.
sections.damage_assessment: Clean the area and examine every fastener within 300 millimetres of the strike point. The repair admits surface burn marks up to 0.2 millimetres deep and up to four fasteners showing arc damage at their heads. Any fastener with damage in its shank, any hole elongation, or any burn on the rib flange itself, is outside this repair. Measure the bonding resistance across the affected joint before any work; a resistance above the limit indicates the current has passed through an unintended path and the assessment must be widened to the adjacent bay before anything is disturbed.
sections.repair_procedure: Blend the surface burn marks inside the depth limit and check the residual thickness. Remove every damaged fastener and examine each hole for elongation and for arc damage in the bore. Ream to the next oversize where the bore is marked, keeping inside the limit on the repair drawing. Install new fasteners of the current standard, wet with faying surface sealant, and torque as stated. Where the frame item at the attachment is damaged, replace it with the current item rather than repairing it. Restore the protection scheme and reseal the joint. Measure the bonding resistance again and confirm it is inside the limit at each of the three measurement points.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do an eddy current inspection of every reamed hole before the new fastener is installed. Do a bonding resistance measurement at installation and at the next C check. Do a detailed visual inspection of the repaired region at every A check for the first 1 000 flight hours, then at every C check. A bonding resistance that rises between checks ends the repair and requires a repair approval request.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Surface burn up to 0.2 mm deep; not more than four fasteners with head arc damage; no shank damage, no hole elongation, no burn on the rib flange.

repair_drawings.title: Fin box lower rib lightning strike repair, attachment region

type_data.fastener_pattern: Existing rib pattern retained; damaged fasteners replaced individually, oversize where the bore is marked
type_data.fatigue_life_note: No life limit. Bonding resistance measured at installation and at the next C check; a rising resistance ends the repair.
